headline: Executive order directs changes to the US childhood vaccine schedule to match recommendations used in other developed countries.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order aims to change which vaccines the federal government recommends for children, so the list lines up with what peer developed countries recommend. No summary of the order was provided, so the specific vaccines, agencies, and steps involved are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: The federal list of recommended childhood vaccines they rely on could change.

who_it_affects.group: Pediatricians and other health care providers who vaccinate children
who_it_affects.how: The federal guidance they follow when advising families on childhood vaccines may be revised.
Agencies that set vaccine recommendations would likely be directed to review or update the childhood schedule.
